user.title: Watt Learner
user.description: Learns how many watts a device or device group draws by comparing the house meter shortly before and after it switches. The group counts as on as soon as one member is on.

data_description.meter: A power sensor that reports about every 10 seconds.
data_description.compensation: Optional. Their power is added to the meter reading, e.g. a solar bank feeding the house.
data_description.members: Lights, switches, fans, media players or input booleans.

init.title: Watt Learner
init.description: Saving reloads the entry. The learned values are kept.

data_description.post_delay_s: How long the devices need to reach a steady draw before the meter is read again.
